skillsApplied.intakeReference: independent/sound-a.json records actual full reading and earlier17-summary catalog intake.
practicalWorkflow: Assess bio, README and pins as one reading path while preserving their distinct native jobs.
Use real wheel-scrolled phone PNGs instead of full-page sticky artifacts.
Keep meaning in native text and quiet imagery; no automatic audio or motion is needed.
Carry identity through versioned source, voice and factual work; require new built-site evidence before evaluating future effects.
exceptions: GitHub owns typography/layout/interaction CSS; no taste-kit hover layer, screen-sized sections, shaders or custom JS.
Native text below a banner is meaningful introduction, not an image caption to remove.
Static GitHub needs no Play/mute/reduced-motion controls for nonexistent media.
Intentional future character performance is separate from short UI feedback timing and preserves keyboard access; optional sound requires separate reversible opt-in and listening evidence.
Required JSON vote replaces standalone skill report templates; no browser or source edits.

limits: These are explicitly labeled unpublished local GitHub DOM previews, not saved settings.
Public-evidence records were read as factual support; I did not independently browse source repositories or test project runtimes.
No physical device, spoken AT, listening, unfamiliar-reader or repeat-visit study was performed.
The written future sound condition is accepted as a design rule, not as implemented website behavior.
